data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'æðel', meaning 'noble'. The 'A' prefix means 'fire, bright'. This name can be used for both males and females in the Christian tradition. The name Athey carries the meaning “Fire, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Athey usually hope their child will grow to embody fire, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
